summary.methodology: Sequential Node fetch calls from this machine, one in flight, shared process/connection pool, four warmup calls excluded. Timer starts before fetch and ends after reading the full response body. No retries. Synthetic snapshots with small deterministic perturbations; when multiple variants are requested they use paired states and alternating order. Accuracy only measures a 300 ms, immediate-action, open-loop collision check; it does NOT measure network-delayed live gameplay. Forecast variant is explicitly assisted by local physics calculations. Observation variant adds current spatial/motion descriptions without action forecasts.
summary.percentiles: Nearest rank; small sample, not a service SLA.
